description: Na₃LiMgCl₆ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six equivalent Cl atoms. There are two shorter (2.88 Å) and four longer (3.01 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. Li is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form LiCl₆ octahedra that share faces with two equivalent MgCl₆ octahedra. All Li-Cl bond lengths are 2.61 Å. Mg is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form MgCl₆ octahedra that share faces with two equivalent LiCl₆ octahedra. All Mg-Cl bond lengths are 2.45 Å. Cl is bonded to three equivalent Na, one Li, and one Mg atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and face-sharing ClNa₃LiMg square pyramids.
